texts.zh:
这座废墟看起来至少有成百上千年那么陈旧了。起初它看起来只是一个大型露天建筑，不过随着对外部结构发掘的深入，我们很快发现这只是一座城市中被废弃的贫民窟。有一座巨大的大门阻挡了我们深入城市的去路，我们的科学家猜想这个社会分为了数个阶层，而建筑的每一层分别居住着这座城市一个阶层的人。

我们的科学家很快就在这座地下废墟破碎的混凝土地面下发现了外星人的遗骸。然而在找到第一具遗骸过后，我们很快发现贫民窟里到处都是遗骸，有的横尸街头，有的死在家中，有的从天花板上高高地悬挂下来。虽然不知道是谁干的，但真的是一副相当令人反胃的场景。
texts.en:
The ruins seem to be centuries, if not millennia, old. At first it seems to be only a large open-air dome, but as we are excavating the outermost parts we quickly find ourselves in what appears to be the derelict slums of a city. As a large gate blocks our progress deeper into the city, our scientists speculate that it is split into a hierarchy, each layer holding one class of the people of the city.

It does not take long before one of our scientists finds alien remains in subterranean ruins under the broken concrete floor. After the first corpse is found, however, we start finding remains all over the slums, be it in the streets, in what would have been their homes, or hanging from the most remote parts of the ceiling. It is unclear what killed them, but it is a grisly sight.

label.zh: 那么其他层里又为我们隐藏着什么呢？
label.en: What do the other layers have in store for us?

texts.zh:
第一个圈子似乎是由流浪汉和贫民们摇摇欲坠的窝棚组成，而第二个圈子则与[Root.GetAdj]市政规划观念有很多一致之处。

我们发现了几个我们的科学家认为曾经是集市的开放广场，但因为年深日久，所有东西都早已腐朽到无法辨认它可能是什么的地步。

之后不久，我们也开始在圆顶的这一部分发现值得注意的遗迹。此处居民尸骸遍地，其死亡方式似乎与他们那些穷邻居差不多。
texts.en:
Whereas the first circle seemingly consisted of the ramshackle dwellings of the outcast and destitute, this second circle has more in common with the [Root.GetAdj] notion of proper urban planning.

We find several open squares our scientists assume used to be marketplaces, though anything from back then has long since decayed to the point where it is impossible to make out what it might have been.

It does not take long before we start finding unusual remains in this part of the dome too. They seem to have perished in much the same way as their poorer neighbors, and we find the dead strewn all over.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的物种形容词。
note.en: In the game, your species' adjective appears here.

texts.zh:
当进入第三层的大门最终打开后，我们的科学家们——带着对下一步的发现的好奇——鱼贯而入，而这里很快被确认为是该穹顶古建筑中的一个更富有的区域。我们可就此对从这座城市可能获得的发现做出更积极的期望。

进入这一层后不久，我们中的一个人突然转身，野蛮地袭击了一位同事。当该袭击者被制服时，受害者已经死在地上。此后，那位发疯的科学家一直胡言乱语，我们完全无法理解他们身上到底发生了什么。

这一层比前两层都小，很可能是我们到达圆顶中心之前的最后一层。只剩下一扇门了。
texts.en:
When the gate into the third layer finally opens, our scientists - curious about what they will find next - flood into what is soon identified as a yet wealthier region of the old dome. At this point we can make confident assumptions about what to expect from this city.

Shortly after we enter the layer, one of our people suddenly turns around and savagely attacks a colleague. The victim is already dead on the ground by the time the unexpected assailant is restrained. In the aftermath we are completely unable to get anything sensible out of the crazed scientist, and get no better understanding of what happened to them.

This layer is significantly smaller than either of the previous two, and it is most likely the final one before we reach the center of the dome. Only one gate remains.

label.zh: 我们的科学家随时准备探索最后一层。
label.en: Our scientists stand ready to check the final layer.

texts.zh:
当最后一扇门开启时，强烈的灵能波冲击着我们的科学家。他们中的大多数在剧烈的痛苦中崩溃了，最终只有少数人进入了这一层。

这一层似乎是一座大寺庙，中间有一个巨大的祭台或祭坛。墙上到处都是描绘不同恒星系的巨大图表，一个重复的图表似乎围绕着[Root.System.GetName]本身。

幸存为数不多的的几位科学家向中央靠拢，他们发现这实际上是一台打造成古老祭坛形式的雄伟机器。
texts.en:
As soon as the final gate opens up, waves of intense psionic energy wash upon our scientists. Most of them collapse in apparent agony, leaving only a few to make their way into the actual layer itself.

It seems to be a large temple, with a massive dais or altar in the middle of it. All across the walls there are huge diagrams of different star systems, and a repeated one seems to center on [Root.System.GetName] itself.

Making their way closer to the middle, the few scientists that remain find that it is in fact an imposing machine fashioned in the form of an old altar.

label.zh: 让我们修一下这台机器，看看能发现什么。
label.en: Let us tinker with this machine and see what we can find.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

texts.zh: 当修理工作开始时，他们突然被一种共同的幻觉所困扰——一个正被挖出并解封的存在，尖啸着发出命令。尖啸越发刺耳，一个生物撕开[From.System.GetName]星系的景象在他们的脑海中反复上演。几位科学家不省人事，无法应对这种持续折磨他们身体疼痛。
texts.en: As they start tinkering with the machine, they are suddenly beset by a shared auditory hallucination - a screaming command by something to be unearthed, unshackled. Visions of a creature ripping apart the [From.System.GetName] system plays repeatedly in their heads as the creature's demands grow shriller. Several scientists fall unconscious, unable to deal with the unabating torrents of pain that rack their bodies.

label.zh: 拆了这台机器，以免造成更多的伤害！
label.en: Rip the machine apart before it can cause any more harm!

tooltips.zh: 一个诡异之魇将被释放到[eldritch_location.GetName]恒星系中。
tooltips.en: An Eldritch Horror will be released in the [eldritch_location.GetName] system.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the system's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏会在这里填入存档中的名称。
note.en: The game fills in a name from your save here.

texts.zh: 我们与我们穿越[eldritch_location.GetName]星系的舰队失去了联系。随后，我们又收到了其中恒星坍缩和一切毁灭的消息。
texts.en: We have lost all contact with our fleet as it was traveling through the [eldritch_location.GetName] system. Shortly afterwards, we receive news about the collapse of the star and the destruction of everything around it.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名字。
note.en: In the game, this system's name appears here.

texts.zh:
终于……

凡人，跪下！在我面前卑躬屈膝，我将赐予你佑护和智慧。

若敢不从，我将为你带来终结！
texts.en:
FINALLY...

BOW DOWN MORTALS, GROVEL BEFORE ME, AND I SHALL GRANT YOU PROTECTION AND WISDOM.

OPPOSE ME, AND I SHALL BE YOUR END!

label.zh: 啊，伟大的存在！来拥抱你迷途的羊群吧！
label.en: O Great One! Embrace your wayward flock!

tooltips.en: [Root.GetName] will rebuild their starbase in the [eldritch_location.GetName] system.

label.en: It was a mistake to release you.

tooltips.en: [Root.GetName] will become hostile to the Eldritch Horror.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个星系的名字。
note.en: In the game, this system's name appears here.

texts.zh:
尔等既选择了智慧之路。
一切将如其之所应为。
texts.en:
SO YOU HAVE CHOSEN THE PATH OF WISDOM.
EVERYTHING IS AS IT SHOULD BE.

label.zh: 一切将如您所愿，伟大的存在。
label.en: It will be as you wish, Great One.

summary.text:
# 破损的大门 / The Broken Gates

- 分类 Category：先驱者与考古 Precursors · 来源 Sources：common/archaeological_site_types/04_leviathans_arc_sites.txt:3；events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_2.txt:7669 · DLC：《利维坦》Leviathans（脚本文件 04_leviathans_arc_sites） Leviathans · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

随机遗址：基础权重10（需要《利维坦》）；不会出现在恒星、气态巨行星、小行星、起始/首都/黑洞星系或格式塔拥有的星球上；全银河最多一处；仅非格式塔帝国可见（common/archaeological_site_types/04_leviathans_arc_sites.txt:3）。

A random site with base weight 10 (needs Leviathans); never on stars, gas giants, asteroids, starting, capital or black-hole systems, or gestalt-owned bodies; at most one per galaxy; visible to non-gestalt empires only (common/archaeological_site_types/04_leviathans_arc_sites.txt:3).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

一座破碎穹顶按阶层分成四层，越往里越富有也越疯狂；最内层是一座布满星图的神殿和一台机器，里面有被“长者”低语的存在。考古队摆弄机器时，要么撕碎它，要么把它放出来——那会摧毁一个恒星系并让一个“古神”苏醒。

1. 第一层：城市贫民窟与地下遗骸
2. 第二层：整齐的城市规划和集市
3. 第三层：更富裕的区域，一名科学家忽然攻击同事
4. 最后一层：灵能冲击，神殿与指向本星系的星图；摆弄机器

A broken dome split into four class layers, richer and madder toward the middle; the innermost temple holds a machine and a voice that demands to be unshackled. The team can either rip the machine apart or let the Elder One out — which destroys a star system and wakes a cosmic horror.

1. The First Layer: the first layer: slums and remains below
2. The Second Layer: the second layer: orderly planning and marketplaces
3. The Third Layer: the third layer: a wealthier district; a scientist suddenly kills a colleague
4. The Final Layer: the final layer: psionic waves, a temple with star diagrams pointing at this system; tinkering with the machine

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 长者 / The Elder One：a 撕碎机器（工程学研究，获得标本“长者祭坛”，故事结束）；b 放它出来 → 若星系没有黑洞，该系统被摧毁，其他帝国在场的舰队全军覆没（收到 ancrel.11035），并在黑洞星球上创建“古神”守护者国家；10天后 ancrel.11025 / the Elder One: a rip the machine apart (engineering research, the specimen "altar to the Elder One", end); b let it out → if the system has no black hole it is destroyed and other empires' fleets there are lost (they receive ancrel.11035), and the guardian-horror country is created at a black-hole planet; ancrel.11025 follows after 10 days
- 信号传输接入 / Incoming Transmission：古神来电：a 膜拜（影响力月度奖励、在系统建立前哨站、获得修正）→ ancrel.11027“明智之路”；b 后悔放它出来 → ancrel.11030“选择了死亡”（古神敌对） / the horror calls: a worship it (influence reward, an outpost, a modifier) → ancrel.11027 "path of wisdom"; b regret it → ancrel.11030 "chosen death" (hostile)
- 古神被击毁时 ancrel.11040（on_ship_destroyed_victim）会清除其修正并开启一次“恐怖庆典”情境；该事件目前不属于任何可读故事。 / When the horror is destroyed ancrel.11040 (on_ship_destroyed_victim) removes its modifier and starts a "horrific celebration" situation; that hidden event is not part of any readable story.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊的文明差异。 / No empire-specific variants beyond the reward wording.
- 掷骰失败时使用通用事件池 all_random_events（见“考古遗址：发掘意外”）。 / Failed rolls use the generic pool all_random_events (see "Archaeological Sites: excavation incidents").

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：遗址定义（common/archaeological_site_types/04_leviathans_arc_sites.txt:3）的阶段顺序与条件、各阶段事件脚本、出现方式；中英文正文已读。
- Checked: the site definition (common/archaeological_site_types/04_leviathans_arc_sites.txt:3) with its stage order and conditions, every stage event script, and how the site appears; both languages read.
